goal: Create scripts/factory/transcript.mjs — the import-firewalled reducer that turns a worker's Claude transcript JSONL into (a) resolveTranscript(): an exactly-one-match session/transcript resolution keyed by the dispatch's own id, (b) an AgentUsage token split deduped by message.id (last occurrence in file order wins) BEFORE summing, and (c) back-fillable tool_call tuples with historical timestamps. No repo module imports it yet (be-41-03/04/05 wire it), and it imports nothing from the repo except node builtins, so the slice is inert and independently reviewable. Runs in parallel with be-41-01 — disjoint new files, no shared shape between them.
constraints: conventions.md 2026-08-07 (import-firewalled reducer — this is the THIRD instance after triage.mjs and browser-evidence.mjs): the reducer imports NOTHING from this repo and is imported by no decision module; the firewall is asserted by a source-text test in BOTH directions; the reduction is counts plus closed enums, never free prose; an unrecognized shape fails toward the UNSAFE reading; and a seeded-marker mutation test proves the raw bytes reach neither the produced JSON, nor stderr, nor any file under stateDir/taskDir.

Dedupe BEFORE summing, exactly as scripts/task-cost-log.mjs:139-159 does: one Map keyed by message.id, LAST occurrence in file order wins. Claude Code writes one assistant message as several JSONL lines (one per content block) each repeating message.id, and output_tokens EVOLVES mid-stream — a live capture shows 5 -> 5 -> 400 for one message. Summing every line yields 410; the correct answer is 400. That over-count is issue #56's bug and reproducing it is the named forbidden outcome.

Never derive the ~/.claude/projects dash-encoding. Resolution is a plain filename scan for <id>.jsonl across every project directory, exactly as scripts/task-cost-log.mjs:109-129's findTranscript does (live-confirmed at issue #41's U-1 probe: the transcript landed at ~/.claude/projects/-Users-x-Development-dev-team-claude-plugin/<uuid>.jsonl and was found by a plain filename scan).

findTranscript's refusal posture is converted from THROW to null: 0 matches -> null (expected on early poll ticks, so NOT logged per call, only counted); >1 matches -> null plus one log line, NEVER a guess. Ambiguity degrades to denial, never to a wrong row.

scripts/factory/* is on the Node >= 24 floor, but this module uses no floor-gated builtin — keep it importable and fully testable on Node 20 (conventions.md 2026-08-08 scoped-floor entry: the floor is scoped to what actually needs it).
conventions.md 2026-08-08 (source-text needles): every source-text assertion builds its needle from fragments, and this file is authored to avoid the bare token in its own comments.

conventions.md 2026-08-08 (real-shape fixtures): a fixture standing in for 'what a real transcript looks like' must be a captured real shape, not a field list derived from a description — include one complete real-shape assistant-message triple (same message.id, evolving usage) plus the tool_use/tool_result shapes.
conventions.md 2026-08-01: no typecheck/lint tooling exists in this repo — validation is the filtered test run only.
This module must never write anything. It reads files and returns plain objects.
acceptance_criteria: DEDUPE PINNED ON THE REAL CAPTURE: a fixture reproducing the live 5 -> 5 -> 400 triple (three consecutive lines, one message.id, evolving output_tokens) asserts billed_output_tokens === 400, NOT 410 — the #56 over-count. Test in test/factory-transcript.test.mjs.

C2 DERIVATIONS EXACT, each asserted separately against a multi-message fixture: billed_input_tokens = sum(input_tokens); billed_output_tokens = sum(output_tokens); billed_cache_write_tokens = sum(cache_creation_input_tokens); billed_cache_read_tokens = sum(cache_read_input_tokens); raw_read_tokens = sum(input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens) with cache_read_input_tokens EXCLUDED; raw_written_tokens = sum(output_tokens); context_tokens = the LAST surviving message's input + cache_read + cache_creation; context_window = null.

RESOLUTION REFUSES BOTH WAYS AND COUNTS THEM DISTINCTLY: 0 matching <id>.jsonl files -> null with a missing-count and NO log line; 2+ matches (the same id present under two project dirs) -> null with an ambiguous-count and exactly ONE log line; exactly 1 match -> {claude_session_id, transcript_path}. A test asserts the dash-encoding is never derived (source-text needle: no code path constructs a project-dir name from a cwd).

NO-SUBAGENTS ASSUMPTION SHIPS AS A TEST, NOT A COMMENT: a drift guard reads scripts/cmux/contract.mjs's frozen DISALLOWED_TOOLS (contract.mjs:12) and fails if it stops excluding all of 'Task', 'Agent' and 'mcp__*' — because if any role ever gains Task, this reducer silently under-counts usage (subagent turns live in <session-id>/subagents/*.jsonl sidecars, never inline; backend-notes.md 2026-08-08). The guard reads contract.mjs's SOURCE TEXT (readFileSync + regex), never imports it — importing would breach the firewall.

IMPORT FIREWALL, BOTH DIRECTIONS: a source-text test asserts (a) scripts/factory/transcript.mjs contains no import from anywhere in this repo (node: builtins only), and (b) no decision module (scripts/cmux/ladder.mjs, scripts/cmux/triage.mjs, scripts/cmux/contract.mjs) imports it.

SEEDED-MARKER MUTATION TEST: a hostile fixture seeds a unique marker string into assistant text, a tool name, and a tool_result body; the test asserts the marker appears in NONE of the returned objects (JSON.stringify of every return value), NOT in captured stderr, and in NO file written under the test's stateDir/taskDir. Removing the reduction must make this test fail — verify that by temporarily bypassing it.

TOOL NAMES ARE SHAPE-GUARDED TO A CLOSED SET: a tool name not fully matching the closed allowed pattern maps to the literal 'other'; the raw name is never forwarded. Asserted with an ANSI-escape/newline/5000-char tool name.

MALFORMED INPUT NEVER THROWS AND NEVER GUESSES: a truncated final line, a non-JSON line, a line whose message lacks usage, an empty file, and a missing file each produce a well-formed result (or null for resolution) with the corresponding count incremented — no throw, no partial-credit guess.

TOOL_CALL BACK-FILL CARRIES HISTORICAL TIMESTAMPS: each returned tool tuple is {tool, ok, started_at, ended_at} sourced from the transcript's own timestamps (so be-41-05 can pass them to recordEvent rather than letting it default to now()); a denied/failed call is ok:false (U-3: #41 does not distinguish denied from failed).

DEEP REVIEW REQUIRED: scripts/factory/*.mjs is deep-review class (config.md:48). Gate with dev-team:code-reviewer-deep plus a dev-team:test-engineer mutation pass — test-engineer owns hypothesising mutations beyond those named here (dedupe key swapped to requestId, last-wins flipped to first-wins, cache_read wrongly folded into raw_read).
The filtered test run in validation_commands passes.

interface_contract:
PRODUCED HERE. be-41-03 (pins the id), be-41-04 (per-tick resolution) and be-41-05 (usage + tool_call back-fill) consume these verbatim and must not redefine them.

=== C3 — TranscriptResolution ===
resolveTranscript({record, projectsDir}) -> {claude_session_id, transcript_path} | null
Under ADR-026 clause 3 this is findTranscript(projectsDir, record.dispatch_id)'s scan (scripts/task-cost-log.mjs:109-129) with its refusal posture converted from throw to null: 0 matches -> null plus stats.resolution_missing++ (EXPECTED on early ticks, so NOT logged per tick); >1 matches -> null plus stats.resolution_ambiguous++ plus one log line, NEVER a guess. Never derive the project-dir dash-encoding (that module's header rule). Called once per unresolved dispatch per await tick; the result is PINNED on first success and never re-resolved, so a transcript later forked, rotated or duplicated cannot move the answer. The two counter names are the sidecar's (be-41-01) — this module returns them on its result object; it does not write the sidecar.

=== C2 — AgentUsage ===
readUsage({transcriptPath}) -> {billed_input_tokens, billed_output_tokens, billed_cache_write_tokens, billed_cache_read_tokens, raw_read_tokens, raw_written_tokens, context_tokens, context_window, message_count, dropped_lines}
Computed per #40 spec section E, AFTER dedupe by message.id (last occurrence in file order wins):
  billed_input_tokens = SUM(input_tokens)
  billed_output_tokens = SUM(output_tokens)
  billed_cache_write_tokens = SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens)
  billed_cache_read_tokens = SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
  raw_read_tokens = SUM(input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens)   // cache_read_input_tokens EXCLUDED from raw
  raw_written_tokens = SUM(output_tokens)
  context_tokens = last surviving message's (input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens)
  context_window = null   // U-4, no verified source in #41
These ten keys map 1:1 onto ledger.endAgentSession's ten required fields (scripts/factory/ledger.mjs:993-998), all of which accept explicit null but reject undefined (:645-655) — so an unknown value is null, never omitted.
PINNED ASSUMPTION: a worker session never spawns subagents, so NO <session-id>/subagents/*.jsonl walk is required for completeness — DISALLOWED_TOOLS (scripts/cmux/contract.mjs:12, frozen) excludes Task/Agent/mcp__* and is always applied (scripts/cmux/record.mjs:572, :651). RE-ENTRY CONDITION: if any role ever gains Task, these numbers silently under-count — which is why the assumption ships as a drift-guard test referenced from this module's header, not as a comment.

=== ToolCallTuple ===
readToolCalls({transcriptPath}) -> [{tool, ok, started_at, ended_at}]
`tool` is a member of a closed, shape-guarded name set; anything unrecognized is the literal 'other'. `ok` is false for both a failed and a denied call (U-3 deferred). started_at/ended_at are the transcript's own historical ISO timestamps, so be-41-05's back-filled recordEvent{tool_call} carries real times instead of recordEvent's now() default (scripts/factory/ledger.mjs:809-810). Keys map onto PAYLOAD_KEYS.tool_call = ['tool','ok'] — never pass a key the allowlist would drop.
